name: Toybox Fable captions
measured: Pass 2 re-check (11-26): on both formats the caption glyphs are 42 px cap height in the 720x1280 reels = 63 px at 1080 wide. With Poppins Bold (cap height 0.71 em) that is a font size of 88 px. The short format's white line and keyword line are the SAME size; their baselines are 88 px apart. The stroke is about 5 px at 720 (about 7 px at 1080). Pass 1 numbers (70/86/72-78 px) were glyph-height guesses and are replaced by these.

font.file: Poppins-Bold.ttf (Google Fonts, SIL Open Font License)
font.size_note: 88 px is the em size, as used by FreeType, PIL, ffmpeg drawtext and Blender text objects. libass (ASS files) scales the font's whole line height instead, so the same look needs ASS Fontsize 156 and a +13 px y offset (calibrated in pass 2: renders 62-64 px caps with the block centre at y 503).

shadow.note: soft drop shadow from pass 1, not re-measured

keyword_colours.rule: One keyword colour per film, chosen to contrast with that film's dominant colour. Never mix two keyword colours in one film.

green.use: default; against red, stone and daylight sets

yellow_cinematic.use: cinematic variant only: every word in this colour

lines.content: the words before the keyword (omit the line if the card is only the keyword)
the keyword (the noun or verb that carries the joke), the last word(s) of the card

short.keyword_rule: Every card has a keyword. The card ends on its keyword so the reading order never changes (e.g. 'for a whole / YEAR'). Number or noun reveals get a keyword-only card.
short.example_render: line 1 'every kid gets' white, line 2 'ONE WISH' keyword colour (our own words)

long.position_note: 68-73% measured across films; 73% is the default

lines.case: sentence case (capital at a sentence start and for names)

lines.content: a keyword card shows the keyword ALONE

long.keyword_rule: About 1 card in 3 is a keyword card.

animation.in: hard swap, or on ~1 card in 3 a 3-frame scale pop

cinematic.use: only when Jake asks for the cinematic variant (3:4 letterbox, bars 240 px)
cinematic.size_note: estimated from pass 1 (about 60 px glyph height), not re-measured

timing.first_card: on frame 0 (the first caption is already up on the whip frame)
timing.rule: Every cut is a card change (cards never cross a cut). About half of all card changes are also cuts; the rest change the words over the same shot. A card starts on its first word's onset and ends when the next card starts; the last card of a shot ends on the cut.
timing.generator: style_craftee_style.cut_plan() then caption_cards(); burn with post_craftee-style.py captions

reserved_zones.rule: keep it out of the short-format caption band y 400-600

reserved_zones.where: bottom 15% and the right-hand button column
reserved_zones.rule: long captions at 73% stay above it

never: more than 4 words on a card
two keyword colours in one film
